name: Harry Treadaway
bio: Harry John Newman Treadaway (born 10 September 1984) is an English actor known for his performances as Victor Frankenstein in the horror-drama series Penny Dreadful and Brady Hartsfield in Audience's Mr. Mercedes.

credits.overview: Forced to travel West in search of a promised land, the Joad family embark on an epic journey across America in the hope of finding work and a new life in California.
